key_findings: AnxA5 from cell-free fat extract inhibits LPS/IFN-gamma-induced M1 macrophage polarization by promoting calcium-dependent TLR4 internalization and lysosomal degradation, suppressing MyD88-dependent NF-kB signaling.
Intra-articular AnxA5 relieved pain and reduced synovial inflammation and cartilage damage in a rat MIA osteoarthritis model.
